record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, increase item and positional embedding width from 64 to 128, propagating that width through the existing two-block, two-head BERT encoder and its existing proportional feed-forward layers. Greater representation capacity may distinguish diverse item interests, particularly in Electronics. Preserve embedding tying, initialization rule, features, history policy, dot-product scoring, masked loss and optimizer. Update checkpoint metadata and predictor construction together; retain exactly one trained checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Increase embedding width from 64 to 128 across all four datasets to test greater representational capacity. Existing width-dependent encoder layers, checkpoint metadata, and predictor construction automatically propagate the new width. Preserve two blocks, two heads, tied embeddings, initialization, scoring, masked training, loss, and optimizer.
